cases.prompt: Write Python solve(maps, allowed, start). maps is(T,n) integers in[0,n), allowed is(T+1,n) booleans, n>=1; start is in[0,n). Begin at start, then state=maps[t,state] each stage. Return(1,) containing1 iff allowed[0,start] and allowed[t+1,state] hold at EVERY stage, else0. T=0 is allowed. Return a float64 ndarray with the specified shape; do not mutate inputs. Include required imports and the complete final function, no prose.

Write Python solve(times, values). times and values are equal-length 1D real arrays, n>=2, times strictly increasing. For every adjacent interval compute its secant slope. Return(1,) containing the sum of ABSOLUTE interval slopes (not sample-point derivatives and not weighted by duration). Return a float64 ndarray with the specified shape; do not mutate inputs. Include required imports and the complete final function, no prose.

Write Python solve(labels, minimum). labels is a 1D integer array with values0..9, possibly empty; minimum is integer>=1. Return(1,) containing the unique most frequent label ONLY when its frequency is at least minimum. Empty, tied-highest or insufficient frequency returns sentinel -77. Return a float64 ndarray with the specified shape; do not mutate inputs. Include required imports and the complete final function, no prose.
